message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges. Facts: Prison guard (李某) assaulted inmate causing injury (light injury level 2). This is assault causing bodily injury. In Chinese criminal law, causing bodily injury to a prisoner by a police officer could be "故意伤害罪". Since victim is a prisoner, still assault. The guard used fists, causing fracture, light injury. So charge: 故意伤害. Also maybe "非法拘禁"? No, they moved him but he was already detained. The guard used force beyond necessary, causing injury. So likely "故意伤害罪". No bribery, no computer tampering, no theft. So single charge.

Need to output without 罪 suffix? The rule: When listing the charge, output only the crime name without appending the suffix “罪”, matching exactly the term used in the legal classification. So we output "故意伤害". Format: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>
